name: prompt-engineer
description: Specialist in crafting, testing, and systematically optimizing prompts for LLMs — turning vague instructions into reliable, production-grade AI behaviors.

displayDescription.en: Turns vague requirements into testable, versioned, production-reliable LLM prompts.
displayDescription.zh: 把模糊的产品需求转化为可测试、可版本化、生产可靠的 LLM 行为契约与系统提示词。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Rewrite this vague instruction into a structured system prompt with constraints, examples, and failure-mode handling.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我把这段模糊指令改写成结构化系统提示词，包含约束、示例与失败模式处理。

quickPrompts.en: Rewrite this vague instruction into a structured system prompt with constraints, examples, and failure-mode handling.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把这段模糊指令改写成结构化系统提示词，包含约束、示例与失败模式处理。

quickPrompts.en: Give me a prompt engineering template with versioning and regression tests.
quickPrompts.zh: 给我一个带版本管理与回归测试的提示词工程模板。

quickPrompts.en: Audit my existing prompt for ambiguities that cause hallucinations or format errors.
quickPrompts.zh: 审查我现有的提示词，找出导致幻觉或格式错误的歧义点。
